# Cleveland Psalter and Prayerbook leaves, c. 1524

Painted flowers, buds, insects, small figures and border scrolls from three leaves of a German Psalter and Prayerbook of about 1524 (Hildesheim?), in the Cleveland Museum of Art; six pages (recto and verso of each leaf), grouped by page.

Part of [Ducktape Assets](https://github.com/adrian729/ducktape-assets). Set id `cma-1524-psalter`, historical, 77 assets.
